about: Northern Ireland council rounds 1921-67 that hold fewer divisions or wards than the council elected at that date: one line each, shown on the Browse election page and in the map panel. Built by D:/civgraph-intake/ni-councils-instalment-2/round_completeness.py from the staging work records; the expected counts are the authorities' schemes and the counts the rounds' own notes state. A round marked complete holds every division but those the law left vacant, which its line names.

antrim-county-council__1920-06-03.text: All five electoral areas and every candidate are filed. strabane-rural-district-council__1924-05.text: Results for 21 of 28 district electoral divisions. The other seven had no nomination and were filled by co-option at the first meeting (2 June 1924); a co-option is not an election.

strabane-rural-district-council__1936-06.text: Results for 27 of 28 district electoral divisions. Clady had no nomination; its retiring member (co-opted after 1933) is not named in the sources searched.

tyrone-county-council__1924-05-28.text: Results for 21 of 27 county electoral divisions. The other six (Ballygawley, Carrickmore, Coagh, Dromore, Plumbridge, Pomeroy) had no nomination and were left vacant.
